Good paintwork begins long before the paint.

We believe the finish is only as good as the surface beneath it. That is why inspection, diagnosis, preparation and preventive treatment are central to our work.

Every project is approached with attention to detail, accurate measurements, material knowledge and a commitment to clean execution.

A considered process.

Clear communication and disciplined execution from first inspection to final handover.

  1. Inspect

    Understand the space, substrate, defects, measurements and project requirements.

  2. Prepare

    Treat defects and prepare the surface for the selected finish.

  3. Execute

    Apply materials and finishes with precision, consistency and care.

  4. Refine

    Inspect the completed work, correct details and leave the space clean and finished.
